governing_boundary: Proposed exact-action membership for operative transportation/infrastructure governance, technology development or deployment, and research governance/security mechanisms. Parent titles, keywords and another domain's dispositions are leads only. Procedures stay noncounting; ordinary unfinished screening is not a proven absence or source-access hold.
recommendation: Withhold acceptance of Infrastructure membership on current evidence. Technical device criteria and annual tax-classification/list administration do not alone demonstrate a direct development/deployment/research mechanism; inclusion on that basis requires an explicit independent boundary determination.
supporting_case: Section202adds mandatory annual new/emerging-technology device lists and reasons for inclusion/exclusion; classification can be argued to govern deployment eligibility directly.
countervailing_case: Actual duties classify weapons and tax/NFAexceptions. The bill does not itself require procurement/deployment, fund R&D, authorize a research program or establish a general technology-development standard. Do not infer innovation/deployment effects from its title or tax relief.
narrow_recommendation: Preserve portable whole-action meaning; keep candidate membership unaccepted and separate from authority. Recommend against accepting it merely because devices have technical features or a list is updated annually. Do not reclassify other domains or change the locked taxonomy.
historical_context: M13Aexcluded2:70; batch4proposed a contrary candidate membership. Neither historical selection nor a structural test is approval.
